title: 2026 Season Power Rankings
subtitle: Season board — juice the studs, junk the holes. W1 pulse on each row.
method: 45% HQ W1 strength + 20% FAAB + 20% SOS ease + 15% pedigree; HQ scale from 2025 W1 samples.

rankings.blurb: Juice: Fred Warner + Quentin Lake just ran a TNF clinic, Tyler Warren’s the TE premium cheat code, and the LB room is filthy. Junk: Brock Bowers is on ice, Leonard Williams is a one-man DL, and that all-time wins leader still has zero rings to show for it.

Juice: CeeDee + McBride is disgusting, Will Anderson anchors IDP, and $120 FAAB means Kellen can buy every panic. Junk: Goff-only at QB after selling Nix for a ten-spot, RB room is scraps, and Barton’s still eating a roster spot like rent.

Juice: JSN already punched the clock, Breece + Stafford/Darnold give you a real offense, Jalen Carter is a problem. Junk: Micah Parsons is parked on IR, Gesicki is a TE shrug, and $95 FAAB means Luke shops with coupons.

Juice: CMC + Nico + Rice + Dak — that’s a championship spine, and Kyle’s the only dual-era champ for a reason. Junk: Andrews is the TE hope, LB youth is volatile, and if CMC sneezes the whole October script rewrites.

Juice: Ja’Marr Chase + Myles Garrett + $144 FAAB — richest team in the league can buy a title midseason. Junk: Caleb still growing pains, Loveland is a dart, and half the injury list is already on the business card.

Juice: Puka + Kyren + Roquan + Hutch is a real core; Daniels/Baker gives you QB flexibility. Junk: Likely isn’t a TE premium smash, WR depth dies after Evans, and one LAR dud week and the vibe shifts.

Juice: Herbert + Amon-Ra + Walker is a legit open, Hines-Allen/Bosa DL upside if healthy, Mayer’s a nice TE grab. Junk: Rookie chair, IR already collecting names (Bosa), and ‘prove it before Thanksgiving’ isn’t a suggestion.

Juice: Josh Allen is a cheat code in this format; Etienne/Jeanty + Baun give you flash. Junk: WR room is a haunted house, Mesidor isn’t Garrett, and $93 FAAB means one bad week ends the shopping spree.

Juice: Bijan + Burrow/Kyler stack potential, McConkey/Olave juice, Hamilton/Cross DB room travels. Junk: Aaron Donald’s on IR, Strange is a TE meh, and the SOS is a meat grinder — September is survival mode.
Juice: Mahomes + Watt/Hunter DL is veteran violence; Henry/Brown/Irving can still bully weeks. Junk: Kamara and Jacobs already on IR, WR after DK/MHJ gets thin, and ‘pedigree’ doesn’t score tackles.
Juice: Saquon is a button, LaPorta/Goedert TE premium is real, Winfield still cooks. Junk: Poorest FAAB ($83), Nabers hurt, QB carousel after the Nix buy, and the IR list looks like a crime scene.
Juice: Lamar + JJ + Achane + Kelce is a fantasy magazine cover; Bates/Derwin is DB royalty. Junk: Ranked like a floor team for a reason — if the stars don’t smash every week, there’s no Plan B depth.
Juice: Gibbs is a rocket, Crosby/Simmons DL is nasty, London/Pickens can eat. Junk: Hardest remaining slate on the board, Maye’s still a project, and Pacheco/Meyers already collecting dust on IR.

Juice: Hurts + JT + a WR orchard (Adams/Higgins/Flowers) should not be 14th on talent alone. Junk: A.J. Brown’s dinged, TE is Juwan hope, thin DL, and the demons are sleepwalking while the league laughs.
